projectName: Jellycat bunny removable sound module pocket
title: Jellycat bunny given a zip pocket for a removable recorded-voice sound module
description: A customer wanted to turn a new Jellycat bunny into a special toy for their baby, with a recorded voice that plays when the bunny is squeezed. A sound module was recommended and a zip pocket was sewn inside, so the module can be taken out for washing and battery changes.
itemDetails: This is a new Jellycat bunny with soft beige fur, a fluffy white tail and floral print on the inside of its long ears and on its feet. It now has a hidden zip on its back, with a removable sound module inside that plays a recorded voice when the bunny is pressed.
repairDetails: This was a custom job rather than a repair. The customer bought a new Jellycat bunny and wanted to add a sound module with their own recorded voice, so that when the baby presses the bunny it plays the special message. A suitable sound module was recommended. A zip opening was sewn into the back of the bunny, with a fabric pocket inside to hold the module. Because the module sits in the zipped pocket, it can be taken out whenever the bunny needs cleaning, and its battery can be replaced when it goes flat. The finished bunny looks just like new from the front, and the customer was very happy with the result.
